In this edition: Hindu Succession | Grandson Has No Birthright In Property Devolved On Father In Partition Of Grandfather's Estate : Supreme Court; Supreme Court Directs UP Gov To Identify Undertrials Granted Bail But Haven't Been Released From Jail In 75 Districts; Supreme Court Directs WhatsApp And Other Intermediaries To Inform Measures To Prevent Digital Arrest Scam & Cybercrimes; Hum Do, Hamare Do? - Supreme Court Observer; Supreme Court asks P&H HC to decide PIL petitioner’s locus before examining merits of religious conversion allegations; Five days for some, five years for others: What the Collegium's own record says; and 28 more stories.
